batchAdmission: Only large-original-v1 TIFF/GeoTIFF/BigTIFF raster cards select this batch reader.
Original above 2 GiB; probed dimensions above 2000000000 pixels; more than four bands.
Archived case, unsupported profile, invalid or unowned receipt; canonical hash/bytes/key mismatch.
geo422: Request is not an object with exactly sourceId/objectKey/sha256/bytes/window.
Object key prefix, source ID or SHA-256 does not match; bytes is boolean/non-integer/outside 1..2 GiB.
Window lacks required keys or has extra keys; coordinates or step are boolean/non-integer.
Negative x/y; width/height outside 1..256; step outside 1..4096; last selected sample outside source.
Driver is not GTiff; width/height/count below one; above 2000000000 pixels; count above four.
Mixed sample types; selected raw array above 2 MiB; sample kind outside unsigned/signed/float.
Band-specific nodata differ; band masks differ; CRS WKT above 8192 characters; artifact above 4 MiB.
Verified cache has invalid hash/size, an original above its budget, insufficient free space or write failure.
Download exceeds receipt, is short, or has another hash; native Rasterio/OSError/ValueError/TypeError.
Malformed JSON, missing body or non-object HTTP body also get framework validation 422 (unchanged).

design: Remove source-band admission/schema cap, not pixel/byte/result limits; stream one selected window band at a time.
Describe every source band with original dtype, nodata, colour interpretation and unscaled window statistics.
Choose interpreted RGB, otherwise first three, otherwise grey; palette maps its colour table.
GDAL reads stripes, tiles, BigTIFF, separate planes, predictors and matching internal overviews.
Numeric display is stretched independently per window/channel at percentiles 2..98; invalid pixels are clear.
Export canonical deflate/interleaved uint8 RGBA with explicit alpha; source sample/height tags are not copied.
Metadata and artifact mark display_only; measurement/height remain not_qualified; old receipts stay readable.
Geo 422 uses CODE: sentence; nativeRasterWindow preserves both, including actual legacy cache-integrity wording.

remainingReaderCodes.RASTER_SOURCE_INPUT / RASTER_SOURCE_LIMI: Invalid pins or receipt size outside the unchanged ceiling.
remainingReaderCodes.RASTER_WINDOW_INPUT / RASTER_WINDOW_LIMI: Invalid window shape, size or sampling step.
remainingReaderCodes.RASTER_WINDOW_OUT_OF_BOUNDS / RASTER_DIM: Window outside source or source outside pixel bounds.
remainingReaderCodes.RASTER_FORMAT / RASTER_SAMPLE_TYPE: Not GTiff or unsupported numeric sample type, including complex samples.
remainingReaderCodes.RASTER_COMPRESSION / RASTER_PREDICTOR /: Unavailable decoder or invalid colour table.
remainingReaderCodes.RASTER_CRS_LIMIT / RASTER_METADATA_LIMIT: CRS or all-band descriptions exceed existing bounded metadata.
remainingReaderCodes.RASTER_MEMORY_LIMIT / RASTER_ARTIFACT_LI: Unchanged raw-band or artifact byte ceiling.
remainingReaderCodes.RASTER_SOURCE_INTEGRITY / RASTER_CACHE /: Receipt mismatch, cache failure or damaged bytes.
